name: Recursive ascent LR(1) parser code generator

mentions.name: Recursive ascent LR(1) parser code generator
mentions.description: A code generator that produces recursive ascent parsers for LR(1) grammars, achieving linear-time parsing with reduced overhead and incorporating a set of optimizations described in accompanying blog posts.
mentions.problem: Existing recursive ascent parsers carry runtime parsing overhead.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have a recursive ascent code generator with a bunch of optimisations that I wrote about [1,2]; it's a linear-time parser for LR(1) with reduced overhead.

evidence.value: I have a recursive ascent code generator with a bunch of optimisations that I wrote about [1,2]; it's a linear-time parser for LR(1) with reduced overhead.
